finding.summary: The frozen runner checked the case count but did not reject full-length grader reports containing transport/protocol failure categories.

timing: Discovered by independent review after the frozen run completed. This correction is prospective and was not used to generate or analyze the historical outcomes.

prospective_guard.validator_location: validate_candidate_grade_report in the frozen experiment runner; no runtime-package file was added
prospective_guard.semantics: Accept a full-length report only when each case has a unique id, a boolean outcome, and failure null or wrong_output; require task outcome to equal the conjunction of cases. Raise ExperimentStop on missing_result, malformed_result, inconsistent outcomes, or malformed reports before returning a reward.
prospective_guard.historical_v1_reuse: The current runner no longer matches the frozen v1 implementation hash, so v1 preflight must fail before any grader call. Do not rerun the consumed task. A future experiment requires a fresh task and a new protocol/lock.

historical_outcome_audit.audit_source: results/verifier_integrity_policy_gradient_v1/run2/training-events.jsonl.gz and evaluation-events.jsonl.gz, decompressed and checked against the as-collected manifest
